listings.title: Chinese-English / Chinese-Hindi Translator
listings.snippet:
Position: Chinese-English / Chinese-Hindi Translator


Department: Projects / Engineering


Location: As per Project Requirement


Reporting To: Project Manager / Project Head


Employment Type: Full-Time


Job Summary


We are looking for a fluent translator with expertise in Chinese-English or Chinese-Hindi translation, specifically for technical and construction documents. The candidate will be responsible for providing translation and interpretation for project meetings, translating technical documents and drawings, and facilitating effective communication between Chinese and local teams.
